Chapter 977  Chapter 31 Suppression (Please Subscribe)

At the edge of the universe, in starry space.

Tens of Twelfth Order Ultimates looked solemn, as the sky-reaching Grand Path formed from countless rules laid out before them, not far away.

A young man walked upon these rules, arriving in their midst.

"Galaxy Master!"

The hearts of the many Twelfth Order Ultimates were heavy, knowing that even after their refusal of the human civilization's proposal, they would eventually have to face the Galaxy Master.

But this moment arrived all too soon.

Just a second ago they had rejected the Xuanyuan Supreme, and in the next, the Galaxy Master had come.

And with the strength of the Galaxy Master, he could have arrived silently, but he chose to approach so openly and evidently.

What did this mean?

It meant absolute power.

The Galaxy Master was very confident in himself.

Having reached the Twelfth Order, their minds worked at incredible speeds, and they quickly came up with numerous speculations.

"Galaxy Master, do you really intend to leave us with no way out?"

The Yu Clan Ultimate spoke gravely, as each and every Twelfth Order Ultimate brimmed with a terrifying aura, ready to unleash their full power at any moment.

As for fleeing?

They were no fools; the universe was only so big, where could they escape to?

On the contrary, if the Twelfth Order Ultimates scattered and fled, it would only give the Galaxy Master a chance to break them one by one.

The only thing the Twelfth Order Ultimates could do now was to pool all their strength, to see if they could withstand the Galaxy Master.

If the Galaxy Master couldn't overcome them, that would be their victory.

"Submit to humanity, hand over ninety percent of your Twelfth Order weapons, treasures, and curiosities—that is your way out," Lin Yuan said calmly and indifferently.

"We can submit to humanity, but can we give fewer Twelfth Order weapons, treasures, and curiosities?" The Yu Clan Ultimate's expression changed before he finally spoke.

This was their biggest compromise. Twelfth Order weapons, treasures, and curiosities were crucial for these Ultimates to face the potential cataclysm of the future universe.

They absolutely could not suffer loss in this regard.

"It seems you are still hopeful," Lin Yuan looked at the many Twelfth Order Ultimates.

In fact, demanding ninety percent of their Twelfth Order weapons, treasures, and curiosities was already Lin Yuan being merciful, considering the difficulty of reaching the Twelfth Order.

"Galaxy Master, let's see what your true strength is now." The Yu Clan Ultimate's brow shone with dazzling light as a towering palace covered all of the Twelfth Order Ultimates within.

This palace was the Yu Clan's strongest defensive Clan Suppression Weapon, originating from the dawn of the universe, having fallen from the Chaos Void.

The towering palace was a Path Splitting Realm peak secret treasure, theoretically capable of blocking the attack of a peak Path Splitting Realm being—its only flaw was the massive energy consumption.

But with dozens of Twelfth Order Ultimates present, the cost was spread among them, making it much more manageable.

The Yu Clan Ultimate dared to bargain with Lin Yuan because of this peak Path Splitting Realm defensive secret treasure.

So what if the Galaxy Master was at the peak of Path Splitting Realm? So what if he was stronger than ordinary Path Splitting Realm peaks? As long as they remained within the bounds of the Path Splitting Realm, not even the Galaxy Master could do anything to this palace.

Seeing this, the many other Twelfth Order Ultimates breathed a slight sigh of relief. Facing the pressure of the Galaxy Master directly was too much, but with this palace standing between them, it felt much better.

"Hopefully, after witnessing the might of this palace, the Galaxy Master will take a step back," the Yu Clan Ultimate thought to himself.

Although the palace could block the Galaxy Master, these Twelfth Order Ultimates couldn't hide inside it forever, could they?

Therefore, a negotiation with human civilization, with the Galaxy Master, was the inevitable outcome.

The Yu Clan Ultimate believed that with the palace, they could negotiate more leeway for themselves.

At least it wouldn't be a situation with no room to resist.

...

In the territory of the Robber Clan.

In front of a mysterious and unknowable wooden cabin.

Lin Yuan sat face to face with two Robber Clan Ultimates.

"A Path Splitting Realm peak defensive secret treasure?"

The Robber Clan Ultimate on the right raised an eyebrow and looking at Lin Yuan, he spoke, "Galaxy Master, would you like our assistance?"

The two Robber Clan Ultimates were despised and repelled by the universal consciousness, running the risk of suppression once they made a move.

But if they could gain the favor of Lin Yuan, the reincarnation of a Great Saint, the two Robber Clan Ultimates were naturally willing to do so.

In the Chaos Void, the deterrence of a Great Saint was immense, and those who reincarnated were typically extraordinary Great Saints.

Only the most extraordinary Great Saints who had completed their journey in the Chaos Realm could be assured that their reincarnated selves wouldn't die prematurely, as for ordinary Chaos Venerables? Reincarnation wasn't much different from sending oneself to death.

Even Chaos Great Saints dared not reincarnate lightly; although both were Great Saints, the extent of memories they carried over after reincarnation differed.

"I can handle it on my own," Lin Yuan said with a subtle smile. At this moment, his presence here was but one of his avatars, while his true self stood before the tens of Twelfth Order Ultimates.

...

The Yu Clan Ultimates and many other Ultimates stood under the starry sky; a towering palace enveloped all of the Twelfth Order, emanating an impressively substantial might.

"Quite the large..." Lin Yuan scrutinized the towering palace and the many Twelfth Order Ultimates within it, "...cage."

Indeed, the towering palace was a Path Splitting Realm peak defensive secret treasure, in quality nearing that of the seven top Path Splitting Realm secret treasures left behind by the 'Cang Weiyang', a ruler-level figure.

"What do you mean?"

The Yu Clan Ultimate was slightly stunned.

The Galaxy Master called this Path Splitting Realm peak defensive secret treasure a great big cage?

Before the Yu Clan Ultimate could fully grasp the meaning of this statement,

Lin Yuan's thoughts barely shifted, and tens of figures emerged from the void in all directions, converging to surround the towering palace that enveloped all of the Twelfth Order Ultimates at its center.

"Is that... the avatars of the Galaxy Master?"
